raw_response: {"diagnosis":"The silver_transactions filter `ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 HOUR` silently drops late-arriving POSTED transactions. From batch 3 on, about 25% of each batch has txn_ts roughly 3 days before ingest_ts, and that is what the filter removes. txn_id is unique across raw (4866 distinct of 4866 rows), so removing the filter cannot introduce duplicates. No change note documents a lateness cutoff.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.8,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
